issue_context.title: [Docs][Tutorial] Refactor Getting Started Guide
issue_context.body:
### Description
References a set of related tasks in the TaskList #43634 created by @geromegrignon 

- [x] [Docs][Tutorial] Typo on 'description'
section: https://angular.io/start#create-the-product-list
Change from Add the product descriptions. to Add the product description.

- [x] [Docs][Tutorial] Product import not explained
section: https://angular.io/start#pass-data-to-a-child-component
The Product import is included in the snippet but the related task only refers to the Input.

```
import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { Input } from '@angular/core';
import { Product } from '../products';
```

- [x] [Docs][Tutorial] typing consistency
section: https://angular.io/start#pass-data-to-a-parent-component
The product @Input was previously defined using the non-null assertion operator: @Input product!: Product;. The tutorial should be consistent about its usage.

```
export class ProductAlertsComponent {
  @Input() product: Product | undefined;
  @Output() notify = new EventEmitter();
}
```

- [x] [Docs][Tutorial] Pass data to a parent component title misleading
section: https://angular.io/start#pass-data-to-a-parent-component
As no data is passed with the example with the event, I would expect a title more close to the one used in the documentation core: Parent listens for child event (https://angular.io/guide/component-interaction#parent-listens-for-child-event)
